elements.element: Customer is not subject to any non-compete restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 is omitted, and Section 12.3 expressly states that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service and that Customer has made no non-compete commitment.

elements.element: Customer is not subject to any field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 expressly permits Customer to conduct business in any field or territory.

elements.element: Any restriction is limited to a specifically named competing product.
elements.evidence: No restriction remains, so there is no broader or unnamed-product restriction.

elements.element: Any restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: No restriction remains, including no post-term restriction.

elements.element: Any restriction is capped at 12 months.
elements.evidence: No restriction remains, so no restriction can exceed 12 months.

elements.element: Any restriction includes a carve-out for Customer's internal development.

elements.element: Any restriction includes a carve-out for Customer's acquisitions.

result.reason: The operative redline fully removes the non-compete and retains broad language confirming Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, sell, use, and conduct business in any field or territory. It reaches the preferred position by deleting only the conflicting restriction, without adding unrelated obligations or relying on the non-operative margin comment.
